svg.title: Ultra Game Stash
svg.script:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://i.postimg.cc">

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family:
        "Comic Sans MS",
        "Comic Sans",
        cursive;
    }
    :root {
      --orange: #ff7900;
      --orange-light: #ffad42;
      --black: #26150b;
      --panel: #3e2212;
      --panel-light: #563019;
      --white: #fff5e9;
      --muted: #c6b8a8;
    }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #1e1009,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #201209);
    }
    button,
    input,
    textarea {
      font: inherit;
    }
    button {
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      background: rgba(30, 16, 9, .96);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px #00000099;
    }
    .brand {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: bold;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 16px #ff790055;
    }
    .brand span {
      color: white;
    }
    nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .nav-button {
      border: 1px solid #59300e;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #482815;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      transition: .2s;
    }
    .nav-button:hover,
    .nav-button.active {
      color: #301a0e;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          var(--orange-light),
          var(--orange));
      border-color: var(--orange-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: auto;
      padding: 28px 20px 60px;
    }
    .page {
      display: none;
      animation: appear .22s ease;
    }
    .page.active {
      display: block;
    }
    @keyframes appear {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(5px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 55px 22px;
      border: 1px solid #66340c;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          140deg,
          #271103,
          #2e190d 65%);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 38px #00000066;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 58px);
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 22px #ff790044;
    }
    .hero p {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 0 auto 22px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 30px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .section-description {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0 0 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }
    .card {
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid #3c291a;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #522d18,
          #321c0f);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #00000044;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }
    .card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      font-size: 21px;
    }
    .card p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .button {
      display: inline-block;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 11px 17px;
      color: #301a0e;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #ffb64f,
          #ff7900);
      font-weight: bold;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform .2s, filter .2s;
    }
    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      filter: brightness(1.12);
    }
    .button.secondary {
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid #5c3518;
      background: #5a321a;
    }
    .button-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }
    .announcement-date {
      color: #ffad42;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .gаmе-image {
      display: block;
      width: calc(100% + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      margin: -20px -20px 14px;
      border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
      background: #2e190d;
    }
    .field {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      margin: 6px 0 12px;
      border: 1px solid #49301c;
      border-radius: 10px;
      outline: none;
      color: white;
      background: #2e190d;
    }
    .field:focus {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff790022;
    }
    textarea.field {
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 90px;
    }
    label {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .status {
      color: var(--muted);
      min-height: 22px;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }
    .footer {
      text-align: center;
      color: #988a7c;
      padding: 28px 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid #39210f;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .settings-launcher {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 1000;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border: 2px solid #ffad42;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #fff5e9;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #3b1b05,
          #301a0e);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 22px #000000aa, 0 0 15px #ff790044;
      font-size: 25px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      transition: transform .2s, background .2s;
    }
    .settings-launcher:hover {
      transform: rotate(25deg) scale(1.06);
    }
    .settings-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1001;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #000000bb;
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    }
    .settings-overlay.open {
      display: flex;
    }
    .settings-dialog {
      width: min(100%, 480px);
      max-height: min(85vh, 700px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid #ff7900;
      border-radius: 20px;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #241105,
          #2e190d 70%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px #000000cc, 0 0 28px #ff790022;
    }
    .settings-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .settings-heading h2 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .settings-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid #68401d;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #21170f;
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .settings-intro {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .layout-option {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 15px;
      border: 1px solid #523116;
      border-radius: 13px;
      text-align: left;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #171411;
      transition:
        border-color .2s,
        background .2s,
        transform .2s;
    }
    .layout-option:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: #ffad42;
    }
    .layout-option.selected {
      border: 2px solid #ff9b2f;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          120deg,
          #422006,
          #1b1510);
    }
    .layout-option strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .layout-option span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .topbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 230px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 26px 14px;
      border-right: 2px solid var(--orange);
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 5px 0 25px #00000088;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .brand {
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin: 8px 0 28px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar nav {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .nav-button {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .footer {
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero {
      text-align: left;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero p {
      margin-left: 0;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight {
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 88% 9%,
          #613336 0%,
          transparent 22%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 8% 40%,
          #36181a 0%,
          transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(
          150deg,
          #110c07,
          #1f0e0f 58%,
          #0d0a07);
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(17, 12, 7, .94);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #663c40;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #00000055;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .brand,
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1,
    body.layout-moonlight .section-title,
    body.layout-moonlight .card h3,
    body.layout-moonlight label {
      color: #fcd3cd;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight nav {
      gap: 8px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button {
      border-color: #624244;
      border-radius: 9px 9px 3px 3px;
      background: #1f1112;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button:hover,
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button.active {
      color: #1f0e0f;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #fde2de,
          #f99e90);
      border-color: #fde2de;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px #f99e902b;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(210px, .85fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px 34px;
      min-height: 300px;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
      text-align: left;
      border: 1px solid #6d4347;
      border-radius: 8px 38px 8px 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          115deg,
          #2d1618 0%,
          #1f1112 56%,
          #170d0d 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 44px #00000055, inset 0 0 45px #f885730a;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
      content: "";
      grid-column: 2;
      grid-row: 1 / span 3;
      justify-self: center;
      width: clamp(130px, 17vw, 205px);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 34% 30%,
          #fff9f8 0%,
          #fddcd7 26%,
          #daa69e 54%,
          #8a585c 72%,
          #412527 73%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 35px #fab3a955, 0 0 95px #c061692a;
      opacity: .9;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 590px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
      grid-column: 1;
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 18px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .card {
      border: 1px solid #5d383b;
      border-radius: 5px 20px 5px 20px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #2c191b,
          #160e0e);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px #00000044;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
      grid-row: span 2;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button {
      color: #210e10;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #fde2de,
          #f99e90);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 18px #f8857322;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button.secondary {
      color: #fef2f0;
      border-color: #7d4348;
      background: #2a191a;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .field {
      border-color: #7d4348;
      background: #160e0e;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .footer {
      border-top-color: #5a3235;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      body.layout-moonlight .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
        display: block;
        width: 105px;
        margin: 24px auto 0;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
        margin: 12px auto 20px;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
        grid-row: auto;
      }
    }
    body.layout-bottom {
      padding-bottom: 82px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #1e1009,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #201209);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .topbar {
      position: relative;
      top: auto;
      padding: 22px 20px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #59300e;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-bottom .brand {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 12px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 900;
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 24px);
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 7px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid #8d4a13;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(12, 10, 8, .96);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #000000bb, 0 0 18px #ff790022;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .nav-button {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      border-radius: 11px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body.layout-bottom main {
      padding-top: 28px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 22px;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .brand {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: clamp(21px, 2.4vw, 30px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar nav {
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .nav-button {
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    body.layout-topbar main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(220px, .8fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px 36px;
      text-align: left;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero p {
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
      margin-top: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-topbar .topbar {
        display: block;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .brand {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar nav {
        justify-content: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero p {
        margin: 0 auto 22px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
    }
    body.layout-imac {
      --imac-accent: #fdd1ab;
      padding-bottom: 150px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% -10%,
          #604227 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 90% 65%,
          #4d2528 0%,
          transparent 38%),
        linear-gradient(
          160deg,
          #180f08,
          #221911 52%,
          #120d09);
    }
    body.layout-imac .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(22, 15, 8, .76);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #b9927055;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #00000033;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    body.layout-imac .brand,
    body.layout-imac .hero h1,
    body.layout-imac .section-title,
    body.layout-imac .card h3 {
      color: #feebda;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      position: fixed !important;
      left: 50% !important;
      right: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      bottom: 14px !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: clamp(7px, 1.2vw, 14px);
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 28px);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #feead835;
      border-radius: 25px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          rgba(69, 52, 37, .82),
          rgba(29, 20, 12, .88));
      box-shadow: 0 15px 42px #00000088, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(145%);
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex: 0 0 68px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 68px;
      height: 68px;
      padding: 6px 3px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #ffffff22;
      border-radius: 19px;
      color: #fff6ee;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #654f3b,
          #3f2f21 62%,
          #342619);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 12px #00000055, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      font-size: 0;
      line-height: 1;
      white-space: normal;
      transform-origin: center bottom;
      will-change: transform;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      transition:
        transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2, .75, .25, 1),
        box-shadow .38s ease,
        border-color .32s ease,
        filter .38s ease,
        background .32s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::before {
      display: block;
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #00000055);
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::after {
      content: attr(data-dock-label);
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #fef4eb;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
      line-height: 1.1;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      letter-spacing: .1px;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=home]::before {
      content: "🏠";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=announcements]::before {
      content: "📣";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=gаmеs]::before {
      content: "🎮";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=сhаt]::before {
      content: "💬";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=about]::before {
      content: "🍁";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=suggestions]::before {
      content: "💡";
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      transition: box-shadow .42s ease, background .42s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav:has(.nav-button:hover) {
      box-shadow:
        0 19px 48px #00000099,
        0 0 26px #fcbf8a14,
        inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff2b;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button:hover {
      z-index: 4;
      transform: translateY(-13px) scale(1.16);
      border-color: #fee1c7b8;
      box-shadow:
        0 14px 28px #00000099,
        0 0 24px #fcbf8a48,
        inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff4a;
      filter: brightness(1.16) saturate(1.08);
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button:hover::after {
      font-size: 9.5px;

    body.layout-liquid {
      background-color: #1e1208 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      background-attachment: scroll !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 12% 8%,
          rgba(251, 168, 95, .20),
          transparent 34%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 86% 18%,
          rgba(249, 151, 136, .17),
          transparent 32%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% 100%,
          rgba(217, 140, 73, .13),
          transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #1e1208 0%,
          #342111 48%,
          #2e2116 100%);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .topbar,
    body.layout-liquid .hero,
    body.layout-liquid .card,
    body.layout-liquid .field,
    body.layout-liquid input,
    body.layout-liquid textarea,
    body.layout-liquid select,
    body.layout-liquid .announcement,
    body.layout-liquid .suggestion-card,
    body.layout-liquid .layout-option,
    body.layout-liquid .footer {
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav {
      backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(140%) !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(140%) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav {
      will-change: transform;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav .liquid-dock-lens {
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .button,
    body.layout-liquid button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(68, 33, 2, .5);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          155deg,
          rgba(252, 199, 153, .46),
          rgba(228, 155, 92, .40) 50%,
          rgba(230, 138, 124, .38)) !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .55) !important;
      box-shadow:
        0 8px 22px rgba(137, 76, 23, .28),
        inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7),
        inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .12) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid .button:hover,
    body.layout-liquid button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close):hover {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(186, 110, 44, .32), inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .85) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid ::placeholder {
      color: rgba(255, 247, 240, .6);
    }
    body.layout-liquid select option {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #392411;
    }

    /* ===== Falling autumn leaves (decoration only) ===== */
    #fallLeaves {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .fall-leaf {
      position: absolute;
      top: -10vh;
      opacity: .55;
      will-change: transform;
      animation: leafFall linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes leafFall {
      0%   { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
      50%  { transform: translate3d(45px, 60vh, 0) rotate(190deg); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(-35px, 125vh, 0) rotate(380deg); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      #fallLeaves { display: none; }
    }

    /* =====================================================================
       SMOOTH ANIMATIONS
       ===================================================================== */
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    /* ---- Page load: header drops in, dock rises, icons pop in one by one ---- */
    @keyframes bodyIn  { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes topIn   { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -18px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } }
    @keyframes dockIn  { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 70px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } }
    @keyframes iconPop {
      from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 26px; scale: .4; }
      to   { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0;    scale: 1; }
    }
    body { animation: bodyIn .7s ease backwards; }
    .topbar { animation: topIn .9s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards; }
    body > nav,
    body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav {
      animation: dockIn 1s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) .12s backwards;
    }
    body > nav > .nav-button,
    body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button {
      animation: iconPop .7s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.45, .55, 1) backwards;
      animation-delay: calc(.3s + var(--ni, 0) * 70ms);
    }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(1), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(1) { --ni: 0; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(2), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(2) { --ni: 1; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(3), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(3) { --ni: 2; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(4), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(4) { --ni: 3; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(5), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(5) { --ni: 4; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(6), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(6) { --ni: 5; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(7), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(7) { --ni: 6; }

    /* ---- Page switching: old page fades out, new page glides in ---- */
    @keyframes appear {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(.992); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }
    @keyframes pageOut {
      to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.994); }
    }
    @keyframes riseIn {
      from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 24px; scale: .97; }
      to   { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0;    scale: 1; }
    }
    .page { animation: appear .55s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1); }
    .page.leaving { animation: pageOut .17s ease-in forwards; pointer-events: none; }

    .page.active .section-title,
    .page.active .section-description,
    .page.active .hero > * {
      animation: riseIn .7s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards;
    }
    .page.active .section-description { animation-delay: .06s; }
    .page.active .hero > :nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .07s; }
    .page.active .hero > :nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .14s; }

    .page.active .grid > .card,
    .page.active > .card {
      animation: riseIn .7s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards;
      animation-delay: calc(.12s + var(--n, 0) * 65ms);
    }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(1) { --n: 0; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(2) { --n: 1; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(3) { --n: 2; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(4) { --n: 3; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(5) { --n: 4; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(6) { --n: 5; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(7) { --n: 6; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(8) { --n: 7; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(9) { --n: 8; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(10) { --n: 9; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(n+11) { --n: 9; }

    /* ---- Cards, buttons, inputs ---- */
    .card {
      transition:
        transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        box-shadow .45s ease,
        border-color .45s ease;
    }
    @media (hover: hover) {
      .card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-5px);
        border-color: #ff790066;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 38px #00000066, 0 0 24px #ff790022;
      }
    }
    .card:has(> img) { overflow: hidden; }
    .card > img {
      transition: opacity .7s ease, filter .5s ease;
    }
    .card > img:not(.is-loaded) { opacity: 0; }
    @media (hover: hover) {
      .card:hover > img { filter: brightness(1.12) saturate(1.1); }
    }

    .button {
      transition:
        transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        filter .3s ease,
        box-shadow .35s ease;
    }
    body .button:active,
    body button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close):active {
      transform: translateY(0) scale(.96) !important;
      transition-duration: .08s !important;
    }

    .nav-button {
      transition:
        transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        background .35s ease,
        color .35s ease,
        border-color .35s ease,
        box-shadow .35s ease;
    }
    body:not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid) .nav-button:active {
      transform: scale(.95);
      transition-duration: .08s;
    }

    .field {
      transition: border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, background .3s ease;
    }

    /* ---- Smooth fade between layouts (View Transitions) ---- */
    ::view-transition-old(root),
    ::view-transition-new(root) {
      animation-duration: .5s;
      animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
    }

    /* =====================================================================
       SETTINGS: pops out of the gear button, like opening an app on a Mac
       ===================================================================== */
    .settings-launcher {
      transition:
        transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1),
        background .3s ease,
        box-shadow .3s ease;
    }
    .settings-launcher:active {
      transform: scale(.9);
      transition-duration: .1s;
    }
    .settings-launcher[aria-expanded="true"] {
      transform: rotate(90deg) scale(.92);
    }

    /* The overlay is always laid out, just hidden, so it can animate both ways. */
    .settings-overlay {
      display: flex !important;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
      backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
      transition:
        background-color .5s ease,
        -webkit-backdrop-filter .5s ease,
        backdrop-filter .5s ease,
        visibility 0s linear .55s;
    }
    .settings-overlay.open {
      visibility: visible;
      pointer-events: auto;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(125%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(125%);
      transition-delay: 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
    }

    /* Closed = a tiny round blob sitting exactly on the gear button. */
    .settings-dialog {
      margin: auto;
      transform-origin: 50% 50%;
      transform: translate3d(var(--gx, 0px), var(--gy, 0px), 0) scale(var(--gs, .11));
      opacity: 0;
      border-radius: 200px;
      will-change: transform, opacity;
      transition:
        transform .5s cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1),
        opacity .26s ease .14s,
        border-radius .5s cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1);
    }
    .settings-overlay.open .settings-dialog {
      transform: none;
      opacity: 1;
      border-radius: 22px;
      transition:
        transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1),
        opacity .2s ease-out,
        border-radius .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .settings-overlay { align-items: flex-start; }

    /* Contents drift in one after another once the window is growing. */
    .settings-dialog > * {
      opacity: 0;
      translate: 0 14px;
      transition-property: opacity, translate, transform, border-color, background, box-shadow;
      transition-duration: .2s, .3s, .25s, .25s, .25s, .25s;
      transition-delay: 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
      transition-timing-function: ease, ease, ease, ease, ease, ease;
    }
    .settings-overlay.open .settings-dialog > * {
      opacity: 1;
      translate: 0 0;
      transition-duration: .45s, .7s, .25s, .25s, .25s, .25s;
      transition-timing-function: ease, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), ease, ease, ease, ease;
      transition-delay:
        calc(.14s + var(--k, 0) * 50ms),
        calc(.14s + var(--k, 0) * 50ms),
        0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
    }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(1) { --k: 0; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(2) { --k: 1; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(3) { --k: 2; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(4) { --k: 3; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(5) { --k: 4; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(6) { --k: 5; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(7) { --k: 6; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(8) { --k: 7; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(9) { --k: 8; }
    .layout-option:active { transform: scale(.985); transition-duration: .08s; }
    .settings-close {
      transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), background .25s ease;
    }
    .settings-close:hover { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* ===== Settings tabs + Panic Key section ===== */
    .settings-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 10px 0 4px;
    }
    .settings-tab {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #523116;
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #171411;
      transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, transform .2s ease;
    }
    .settings-tab:hover {
      border-color: #ffad42;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .settings-tab.active {
      color: #301a0e;
      font-weight: bold;
      border-color: var(--orange-light);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange-light), var(--orange));
    }
    .settings-panel {
      display: none;
    }
    .settings-panel.active {
      display: block;
      animation: appear .35s ease;
    }
    .panic-label {
      margin-top: 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .panic-key-button {
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .panic-key-button strong {
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .panic-key-button.capturing {
      border: 2px dashed #ff9b2f;
    }
    .panic-toggle {
      margin-top: 14px;
    }
    .panic-note {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 4px 0 0;
    }
    body.layout-imac .settings-tab {
      border-color: #674c35;
      background: #271c12;
    }
    body.layout-imac .settings-tab.active {
      color: #2a1d11;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fee0c6, #fcbd86);
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .settings-tab.active {
      color: #1f0e0f;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fde2de, #f99e90);
    }
    body.layout-liquid button.settings-tab.active:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          155deg,
          rgba(252, 199, 153, .55),
          rgba(228, 155, 92, .48) 50%,
          rgba(230, 138, 124, .45)) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid button.settings-tab:not(.active):not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) !important;
      color: #fff7f0 !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid .panic-key-button.capturing {
      border-style: dashed !important;
    }

    /* ===== Theme 6: Schoology (light LMS dashboard look) ===== */
    body.layout-schoology,
    body.layout-schoology * {
      font-family: Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    body.layout-schoology {
      color: #333;
      background: #ebebeb;
    }
    body.layout-schoology #fallLeaves {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 0 28px;
      min-height: 60px;
      background: #fff;
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .brand {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;

    }
    body.layout-schoology .brand span {

    }
    body.layout-schoology nav {
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 2px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .nav-button {
      min-height: 0 !important;
      height: auto !important;
      padding: 20px 14px !important;
      border: 0;
      border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;

      color: #444;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      white-space: nowrap;

    body.layout-schoology .nav-button:hover {

    }
    body.layout-schoology main {
      max-width: 1180px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 370px;
      gap: 0 34px;
      align-items: start;

    }
    body.layout-schoology .page {

    body.layout-schoology .hero {

    body.layout-schoology .grid {

    body.layout-schoology .card {

    body.layout-schoology .settings-launcher {

    body.layout-schoology .settings-dialog {

    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-heading h2,
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option strong {

    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-intro,

    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-close {

      border-color: #c4c8cc;

    }
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option {

    @media (max-width: 820px) {

      }
      body.layout-schoology .nav-button {

    /* Schoology theme: "User • ONLINE" chip and the right-hand To Do side panel */
    .sg-user,
    .sg-side {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-user {

      margin: 0 0 12px;

      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-icon {
      flex: 0 0 13px;
      height: 15px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #1aa28c;
    }

      display: block;
      color: #1c75bc;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item:hover b {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item i {
      display: block;
      font-style: normal;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {

      body.layout-schoology .sg-side {

        grid-row: 2;
        margin-top: 24px;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-schoology .sg-user {
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0 0 10px;
      }
    }

    .sg-done {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .sg-done li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: #333;
    }
    .sg-done li::before {
      content: "✓";
      flex: 0 0 13px;
      height: 15px;
      margin-top: 1px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #1aa28c;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 15px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* ---- Respect "reduce motion" ---- */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
      body, .topbar, body > nav, body > nav > .nav-button,
      .page, .page *, .page.leaving { animation: none !important; }
      .settings-dialog,
      .settings-overlay.open .settings-dialog {
        transform: none !important;
        border-radius: 22px;
        transition: opacity .2s ease !important;
      }
      .settings-dialog > * { translate: none !important; transition-duration: .2s !important; transition-delay: 0s !important; }
      .settings-launcher[aria-expanded="true"] { transform: none; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">🦃 <span>ULTRA</span> GАМЕ STASH</div>

    <nav>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button active" data-page="home" data-dock-label="Home" onclick="showPage("home")">Home</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="announcements" data-dock-label="Announcements" onclick="showPage("announcements")">Announcements</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="gаmеs" data-dock-label="Gаmеs" onclick="showPage("gаmеs")">Gаmеs</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="сhаt" data-dock-label="Сhаt" onclick="showPage("сhаt")">Сhаt</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="about" data-dock-label="About" onclick="showPage("about")">About</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="suggestions" data-dock-label="Suggestions" onclick="showPage("suggestions")">Suggestions</button>
    </nav>

    <div class="sg-user" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sg-avatar"></span><span>User • <b>ONLINE</b></span></div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <section id="home" class="page active">
      <div class="hero">
        <h1>🦃 Ultra Gаmе Stash</h1>
        <p>
          Welcome to your cozy fall gаmіng hideout!
          Find gаmеs, check announcements, talk with other players,
          and suggest what should be added next.
        </p>

        <div class="button-row" style="justify-content:center">
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">🎮 Browse Gаmеs</button>
          <button class="button secondary" onclick="showPage('announcements')">
            📰 Announcements
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
          <h3>🎮 Gаmеs</h3>
          <p>Open your favorite gаmеs from the stash.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">View Gаmеs</button>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
          <h3>💬 Сhаt</h3>
          <p>Talk with other players in the external сhаt.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('сhаt')">Enter Сhаt</button>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
          <h3>💡 Suggestions</h3>
          <p>Tell us which gаmеs or features you want added.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('suggestions')">Suggest Something</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="announcements" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">📰 Announcements</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Updates, news, and announcements. Edit their URLs in the configuration below.
      </p>
      <div id="announcementsGrid" class="grid"></div>
    </section>

    <section id="gаmеs" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">🎮 Gаmе Stash</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Choose a gаmе to open its fetched HTML in a new about:blank tab.
      </p>
      <div id="gаmеsGrid" class="grid"></div>
    </section>

    <section id="сhаt" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">💬 Сhаt Room</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Open the external сhаt to talk with other players.
      </p>

      <div class="card">
        <h3>External Сhаt</h3>
        <p>This сhаt is recommended! More customizable and responsive.</p>
        <button class="button" onclick="openConfiguredСhаt()">Open External Сhаt</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="about" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">🍁 About Ultra Gаmе Stash</h2>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Your Fall Gаmіng Hub</h3>
        <p>
          Ultra Gаmе Stash V2 is a functional website that provides District 303 students with the ability to play a variety of video gаmеs. Some of the gаmеs are AI, and some are real!
Us as students, have discovered that finding gаmеs can become extremely difficult considering our district blocks everything, so we fixed this issue!
Every single gаmе on our website is completely functional and provides a fun experience for students.  Bored in class, no work, or just bored? Then come check out our gаmе selection.
Alongside the gаmеs, we have a сhаtroom to engage with others from your district.
Thank you for using Ultra Gаmе Stash V2!
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="suggestions" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">💡 Suggestions</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Have an idea for the website? Send it in.
      </p>

      
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Suggestion Box</h3>
        <p>Click the button to open the suggestion form in a new tab.</p>
        <button class="button" type="button" onclick="openSuggestions()">Open Suggestion Box 🍂</button>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="margin-top:18px">
        <h3>Game Ratings</h3>
        <p>Rate the games and tell us which ones you like best.</p>
        <button class="button" type="button" onclick="openRatings()">Rate Games ⭐</button>
      </div>
    </section>
    <aside class="sg-side" aria-label="Quick links">
      <div class="sg-card">
        <div class="sg-head"><h3 class="sg-title">To Do</h3></div>
        <div class="sg-sub">Upcoming</div>
        <button type="button" class="sg-item" onclick="goToNav(2)">
          <span class="sg-icon"></span>
          <span><b>Play something fun</b><i>Due whenever you want</i><i>Browse the stash</i></span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="sg-item" onclick="goToNav(1)">
          <span class="sg-icon"></span>
          <span><b>Check the announcements</b><i>Due whenever you want</i><i>Website News</i></span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="sg-item" onclick="goToNav(3)">
          <span class="sg-icon"></span>
          <span><b>Say hi in the chat</b><i>Due right now</i><i>Chat Room</i></span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="sg-item" onclick="goToNav(5)">
          <span class="sg-icon"></span>
          <span><b>Send in an idea</b><i>Due anytime</i><i>Suggestions</i></span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="sg-card">
        <div class="sg-head">
          <h3 class="sg-title">Upcoming Events</h3>
          <button type="button" class="sg-link" onclick="goToNav(1)">Announcements</button>
        </div>
        <p class="sg-empty">No upcoming events</p>
      </div>

      <div class="sg-card">
        <div class="sg-head"><h3 class="sg-title">Recently Completed</h3></div>
        <p class="sg-empty" id="sgCompletedEmpty">Nothing completed yet. Go have some fun!</p>
        <ul class="sg-done" id="sgCompleted"></ul>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </main>

  <button type="button" class="settings-launcher" id="settingsLauncher"
          aria-label="Open website settings" title="Website settings"
          onclick="openSettings()">⚙️</button>

  <div class="settings-overlay" id="settingsOverlay" role="dialog"
       aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="settingsTitle" onclick="closeSettingsFromBackdrop(event)">
    <div class="settings-dialog">
      <div class="settings-heading">
        <h2 id="settingsTitle">🦃 Website Settings</h2>

    const externalСhаtUrl = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/N3rdy3333/UGS/Ultra%20Chat%20-%20Fall.html";

    /*
      ============================================================
      FETCH HTML AND WRITE IT INTO ABOUT:BLANK
      ============================================================

      This follows your example:
        1. Open about:blank immediately from the click.
        2. Fetch the configured URL.
        3. Read the response as text.
        4. Write the HTML into the blank tab.

      Relative asset URLs are given the original page's base URL.
    */

    function openInAboutBlank(url) {
      let parsedUrl;
      let newWindow;

      try {
        parsedUrl = new URL(url);
        if (parsedUrl.protocol !== "https:" || parsedUrl.hostname !== "cdn.jsdelivr.net") {
          throw new Error("Only HTTPS URLs hosted on cdn.jsdelivr.net are allowed.");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert("Invalid URL: " + error.message);
        return;
      }

      // Open the blank tab immediately during the click, before any async work.
      newWindow = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");

      if (!newWindow) {
        alert("Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.");
        return;
      }

      function showLoading() {
        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Loading...</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#ffad42;font-family:sans-serif;" +
            "display:grid;place-items:center;height:90vh}</style></head>" +
            "<body>Loading gаmе...</body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Could not display loading page:", error);
        }
      }

      function showError(message) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;
        const safeMessage = String(message || "Unknown error").replace(/[&<>"]/g, ch => ({
          "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """
        }[ch]));

        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Unable to load</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;padding:30px}" +
            "h2{color:#ffad42}</style></head><body><h2>Could not load this page</h2><p>" +
            safeMessage + "</p><p>The URL must be reachable and return HTML.</p></body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          alert("Could not load page: " + message);
        }
      }

      function writeFetchedHtml(html) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;

        const baseHref = new URL(".", parsedUrl.href).href;
        const baseTag = '<base href="' +
          baseHref.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/"/g, """) + '">';

        html = String(html).replace(/<base\b[^>]*>/gi, "");

        if (/<head\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<head\b[^>]*>/i, match => match + baseTag);
        } else if (/<html\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<html\b[^>]*>/i, match =>
            match + "<head>" + baseTag + "</head>"
          );
        } else {
          html = "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head>" + baseTag +
            "</head><body>" + html + "</body></html>";
        }

        newWindow.document.open();
        newWindow.document.write(html);
        newWindow.document.close();
      }

      showLoading();

      // Apps Script fetches the HTML server-side to avoid browser CORS failures.
      if (window.google && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(writeFetchedHtml)
          .withFailureHandler(error => showError(error && error.message ? error.message : error))
          .fetchRemoteHtml(parsedUrl.href);
      } else {
        // Fallback for copies opened outside Apps Script, if the host permits CORS.
        fetch(parsedUrl.href)
          .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
            return response.text();
          })
          .then(writeFetchedHtml)
          .catch(error => showError(error.message || error));
      }
    }

    function openConfiguredСhаt() {
      if (!externalСhаtUrl) {
        alert("Add your external сhаt URL to the externalСhаtUrl setting in Index.html.");
        return;
      }

      openInAboutBlank(externalСhаtUrl);
    }

    /*
      ============================================================

      ============================================================
    */

    function makeCard(title, description, buttonText, url, extraText, imageUrl) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "card";

      // Optional image. With no URL (or if it fails to load) the card looks exactly like before.
      if (imageUrl && String(imageUrl).trim()) {
        const image = document.createElement("img");
        image.className = "gаmе-image";
        image.alt = title;
        image.addEventListener("load", () => image.classList.add("is-loaded"));
        image.loading = "lazy";
        image.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        image.addEventListener("error", () => image.remove());
        image.src = String(imageUrl).trim();
        card.appendChild(image);
      }

      const heading = document.createElement("h3");
      heading.textContent = title;
      card.appendChild(heading);

      if (extraText) {
        const extra = document.createElement("div");
        extra.className = "announcement-date";
        extra.textContent = extraText;
        card.appendChild(extra);
      }

      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      paragraph.textContent = description;
      card.appendChild(paragraph);

      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.className = "button";
      button.textContent = buttonText;

      // Both gаmе and announcement buttons use the fetch-to-about:blank method.
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        recordCompleted(/^Play/i.test(buttonText) ? "Played " + title + "!" : "Checked announcements!");
        openInAboutBlank(url);
      });

      card.appendChild(button);
      return card;
    }

    function renderGаmеs() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("gаmеsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      gаmеs.forEach(gаmе => {
