        );
      });
    }

    function renderAnnouncements() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("announcementsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      announcements.forEach(announcement => {
        grid.appendChild(
          makeCard(
            announcement.title,
            announcement.description,
            "Open Announcement →",
            announcement.url,
            announcement.date || ""
          )
        );
      });
    }

    /*
      ============================================================
      PAGE NAVIGATION
      ============================================================
    */

    let pageSwitchTimer = 0;
    function showPage(pageId) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".nav-button").forEach(button => {
        button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.page === pageId);
      });

      const next = document.getElementById(pageId);
      if (!next) return;

      const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      const pages = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".page"));
      const current = pages.find(p => p.classList.contains("active") && !p.classList.contains("leaving"));

      clearTimeout(pageSwitchTimer);
      // Finish off any page that was still fading out from an earlier click.
      pages.forEach(p => { if (p !== next && p !== current) p.classList.remove("active", "leaving"); });
      next.classList.remove("leaving");
      if (current === next) return;

      const reveal = () => {
        if (current) current.classList.remove("active", "leaving");
        next.classList.add("active");
        if (window.scrollY > 0) window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth" });
      };

      if (!current || reduce) { reveal(); return; }
      current.classList.add("leaving");
      pageSwitchTimer = setTimeout(reveal, 170);
    }

    /* SUGGESTIONS: opens an ordinary link in a new tab (put your link in suggestionsUrl). */
    const suggestionsUrl = "https://forms.gle/hf6Mupg9d2ZCakRn9";
    const ratingsUrl = "https://forms.gle/FG2uJF8ckC5NkoBb7";

    function openRatings() {
      window.open(ratingsUrl, "_blank", "noopener");
    }

    function openSuggestions() {
      if (!suggestionsUrl) { alert("Add your suggestion link to suggestionsUrl."); return; }
      window.open(suggestionsUrl, "_blank", "noopener");
    }

    /*
      ============================================================
      WEBSITE LAYOUT SETTINGS
      The settings control sits outside the page sections, so it
      remains available when users switch pages.
    */
    const availableLayouts = ["classic", "sidebar", "moonlight", "bottom", "topbar", "schoology", "imac", "liquid"];
    const mainNavigation = document.querySelector(".topbar > nav");
    const originalNavigationParent = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.parentElement : null;

    // ============================================================
    // LIQUID GLASS DOCK ENGINE
    // A single glass lens lives inside the dock, behind the icons. It is described by four
    // spring-driven edges (left/right/top/bottom) so it can MOLD: when the pointer is near the
    // dock's outline the lens is a half-circle arch that is pulled out of that rim (its flat base
    // stays welded to the outline and its dome follows the pointer); as the pointer moves inward
    // the arch swells and rounds off into the full rounded square that cradles the icon. Leaving
    // does the reverse, sinking back into the rim. The lens never leaves the dock's bounds.
    // Everything is transform/opacity in one requestAnimationFrame loop that sleeps at rest.
    // ============================================================
    let liquidDockLens = null;
    let liquidDockReset = () => {};
    function setupLiquidDockLens() {
      if (!mainNavigation || liquidDockLens) return;
      const nav = mainNavigation;
      const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") : { matches: false };

      liquidDockLens = document.createElement("span");
      liquidDockLens.className = "liquid-dock-lens";
      liquidDockLens.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      nav.insertBefore(liquidDockLens, nav.firstChild);
      const lens = liquidDockLens;

      // ---- tiny spring toolkit ----
      const mk = (value, k, c, eps = .02) => ({ x: value, v: 0, t: value, k, c, eps });
      const snap = (s, v) => { s.x = s.t = v; s.v = 0; };
      const atRest = s => Math.abs(s.x - s.t) < s.eps && Math.abs(s.v) < s.eps * 5;
      const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
      const smooth = t => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
      function step(s, dt, K, C) {
        const a = -s.k * K * (s.x - s.t) - s.c * C * s.v;
        s.v += a * dt;
        s.x += s.v * dt;
      }

      const L = {
        l: mk(0, 150, 23), r: mk(0, 150, 23),
        t: mk(0, 130, 21), b: mk(0, 130, 21),
        att: mk(1, 120, 20, .002),      // 1 = welded to the rim (arch), 0 = free rounded square
        pres: mk(0, 110, 19, .002),     // opacity
        press: mk(0, 400, 28, .002)     // mouse/finger-down squish
      };
      const MAG = .16, LIFT = 3, SIGMA = 64, PAD = 10, EDGE_PAD = 3;

      let btns = [];
      function measure() {
        btns = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(":scope > .nav-button")).map((el, i) => {
          const prev = btns[i];
          return {
            el, cx: el.offsetLeft + el.offsetWidth / 2, top: el.offsetTop, w: el.offsetWidth, h: el.offsetHeight,
            s: prev ? prev.s : mk(1, 430, 27, .0008),
            lift: prev ? prev.lift : mk(0, 430, 27, .02),
            press: prev ? prev.press : mk(0, 560, 30, .002),
            infl: 0
          };
        });
      }
      const halfPitch = i => {
        const d = [80];
        if (btns[i - 1]) d.push(btns[i].cx - btns[i - 1].cx);
        if (btns[i + 1]) d.push(btns[i + 1].cx - btns[i].cx);
        return Math.min(...d) / 2;
      };

      const ptr = { inside: false, x: 0, y: 0, down: -1, edge: "bottom" };
      const isLiquid = () => document.body.classList.contains("layout-liquid");
      function localPoint(e) {
        const r = nav.getBoundingClientRect();
        ptr.x = e.clientX - r.left - nav.clientLeft;
        ptr.y = e.clientY - r.top - nav.clientTop;
      }
      // Nearest outline edge, with a little hysteresis so the arch never flickers between edges.
      function pickEdge(navW, navH) {
        const d = { left: ptr.x, right: navW - ptr.x, top: ptr.y, bottom: navH - ptr.y };
        const m = Math.min(d.left, d.right, d.top, d.bottom);
        if (d[ptr.edge] > m + 6) ptr.edge = Object.keys(d).find(k => d[k] === m);
        return d[ptr.edge];
      }
      // The arch: a half circle whose flat base is welded to the rim at the pointer, tip reaching toward the pointer.
      function archRect(edge, depth, navW, navH) {
        const tip = Math.max(6, depth + 8);
        const half = tip;                                  // half-width == height, so it's a true half circle
        const M = 24;                                      // keep clear of the dock's rounded corners
        const px = clamp(ptr.x, half + M, navW - half - M);
        const py = clamp(ptr.y, half + M, navH - half - M);
        if (edge === "bottom") return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: navH - 1 - tip, b: navH - 1 };
        if (edge === "top")    return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: 1, b: 1 + tip };
        if (edge === "left")   return { l: 1, r: 1 + tip, t: py - half, b: py + half };
        return { l: navW - 1 - tip, r: navW - 1, t: py - half, b: py + half };
      }

      function retarget() {
        const motion = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : 1;
        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        let near = -1, best = Infinity;
        if (ptr.inside) btns.forEach((b, i) => { const d = Math.abs(ptr.x - b.cx); if (d < best) { best = d; near = i; } });

        btns.forEach((b, i) => {
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          b.infl = ptr.inside ? Math.exp(-(d * d) / (2 * SIGMA * SIGMA)) : 0;
          b.s.t = 1 + MAG * motion * b.infl;
          b.lift.t = LIFT * motion * b.infl;
          b.press.t = ptr.down === i ? 1 : 0;
        });

        let T;
        if (ptr.inside && near >= 0) {
          const depth = Math.max(0, pickEdge(navW, navH));
          const depthT = smooth(depth / Math.max(20, Math.min(40, navH * .36)));
          const A = archRect(ptr.edge, depth, navW, navH);

          // Full rounded square around the icon under the pointer, clamped to stay inside the dock.
          const b = btns[near];
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          const s = b.s.x;
          const between = smooth(Math.abs(d) / halfPitch(near));
          const fw = Math.min((b.w * s + PAD + 6) * (1 - .2 * between), navW - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const fh = Math.min(b.h * s + PAD, navH - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const visCy = (b.top + b.h) - b.lift.x - (b.h * s) / 2;
          const fx = clamp(ptr.x + (b.cx - ptr.x) * .4 * (1 - between), fw / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navW - fw / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const fy = clamp(visCy, fh / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navH - fh / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const F = { l: fx - fw / 2, r: fx + fw / 2, t: fy - fh / 2, b: fy + fh / 2 };

          T = {};
          for (const k of ["l", "r", "t", "b"]) T[k] = A[k] + (F[k] - A[k]) * depthT;
          L.att.t = 1 - depthT;
          L.pres.t = 1;
        } else {
          // Leaving: the lens sinks back into the rim the pointer left through.
          pickEdge(navW, navH);
          T = archRect(ptr.edge, 0, navW, navH);
          const cx = (T.l + T.r) / 2, cy = (T.t + T.b) / 2;
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : cx;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : cy;
          T = { l: Math.min(cx, rimX) - (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7), r: Math.max(cx, rimX) + (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7),
                t: Math.min(cy, rimY) - (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7), b: Math.max(cy, rimY) + (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7) };
          L.att.t = 1;
          L.pres.t = 0;
        }
        L.l.t = T.l; L.r.t = T.r; L.t.t = T.t; L.b.t = T.b;
        L.press.t = ptr.inside && ptr.down >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
      }

      function render() {
        btns.forEach(b => {
          const g = clamp((b.s.x - 1) / MAG, 0, 1);
          const sc = b.s.x * (1 - .07 * b.press.x);
          b.el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(-b.lift.x).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sc.toFixed(4)})`;
          b.el.style.setProperty("--i", g.toFixed(3));
          b.el.style.zIndex = String(2 + Math.round(g * 2));
        });

        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        const squish = 1 - .06 * L.press.x;
        const vx = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : (L.l.v + L.r.v) / 2;
        const st = clamp(Math.abs(vx) / 1700, 0, .2);            // horizontal liquid stretch while moving
        let w = Math.max(1, (L.r.x - L.l.x) * squish * (1 + st));
        let h = Math.max(1, (L.b.x - L.t.x) * squish);
        let cx = (L.l.x + L.r.x) / 2, cy = (L.t.x + L.b.x) / 2;
        // Hard guarantee: the lens never pokes outside the dock.
        cx = clamp(cx, Math.min(w / 2, navW / 2), Math.max(navW - w / 2, navW / 2));
        cy = clamp(cy, Math.min(h / 2, navH / 2), Math.max(navH - h / 2, navH / 2));
        const sx = w / 100, sy = h / 100;

        // Corner radii (separate horizontal/vertical): while attached, the two tip corners are elliptical
        // quarter-arcs that join into a half circle; base corners (on the rim side) stay tight.
        // As att -> 0 everything blends back to the normal uniform rounded-square radius R.
        const R = Math.min(26, Math.min(w, h) / 2);
        const att = clamp(L.att.x, 0, 1);
        const rb = R - (R - 3) * att;
        const mix = target => R + (target - R) * att;
        const sideEdge = ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right";
        const tipX = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? w - rb : w / 2));
        const tipY = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? h / 2 : h - rb));
        let tl = [tipX, tipY], tr = [tipX, tipY], br = [tipX, tipY], bl = [tipX, tipY];
        const base = [rb, rb];
        if (ptr.edge === "bottom") { br = base; bl = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "top") { tl = base; tr = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "left") { tl = base; bl = base; }
        else { tr = base; br = base; }
        const fx = a => (a / sx).toFixed(2) + "px";
        const fy = a => (a / sy).toFixed(2) + "px";
        lens.style.transform = `translate3d(${(cx - 50).toFixed(2)}px, ${(cy - 50).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sx.toFixed(4)}, ${sy.toFixed(4)})`;
        lens.style.borderRadius =
          `${fx(tl[0])} ${fx(tr[0])} ${fx(br[0])} ${fx(bl[0])} / ${fy(tl[1])} ${fy(tr[1])} ${fy(br[1])} ${fy(bl[1])}`;
        lens.style.opacity = clamp(L.pres.x * 1.8, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
      }

      function allRest() {
        return Object.values(L).every(atRest) && btns.every(b => atRest(b.s) && atRest(b.lift) && atRest(b.press));
      }
      function cleanup() {
        lens.style.opacity = "0";
        lens.style.transform = "translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.01)";
        btns.forEach(b => {
          b.el.style.transform = ""; b.el.style.zIndex = "";
          b.el.style.removeProperty("--i");
          snap(b.s, 1); snap(b.lift, 0); snap(b.press, 0);
        });
      }

      let raf = 0, last = 0;
      function frame(now) {
        raf = 0;
        if (!isLiquid()) { cleanup(); return; }
        let dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
        if (!(dt > 0)) dt = 1 / 60;
        dt = Math.min(dt, 1 / 30);
        const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dt * 240)), h = dt / n;
        const K = reduceMotion.matches ? 4 : 1, C = reduceMotion.matches ? 2 : 1;
        retarget();
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          for (const k in L) step(L[k], h, K, C);
          for (const b of btns) { step(b.s, h, K, C); step(b.lift, h, K, C); step(b.press, h, K, C); }
        }
        render();
        if (!allRest()) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        else if (!ptr.inside) cleanup();
      }
      function start() {
        if (raf) return;
        last = performance.now();
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function enter(e) {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        const wasInside = ptr.inside;
        measure();
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = true;
        // A fresh entrance starts as a zero-size bead sitting exactly where the pointer crossed
        // the outline; re-entering mid-exit simply reverses from wherever the lens currently is.
        if (!wasInside && L.pres.x < .04) {
          const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
          ptr.edge = "bottom"; pickEdge(navW, navH);
          const x = clamp(ptr.x, 0, navW), y = clamp(ptr.y, 0, navH);
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : x;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : y;
          snap(L.l, rimX); snap(L.r, rimX); snap(L.t, rimY); snap(L.b, rimY);
          snap(L.att, 1); snap(L.pres, 0);
        }
        start();
      }
      nav.addEventListener("pointerenter", enter);
      nav.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) { enter(e); return; }
        localPoint(e);
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => {
        if (!isLiquid() || !ptr.inside) return;
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) enter(e); else localPoint(e);
        const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".nav-button");
        ptr.down = btn ? btns.findIndex(b => b.el === btn) : -1;
        start();
      });
      const release = () => { if (ptr.down !== -1) { ptr.down = -1; start(); } };
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
      window.addEventListener("pointercancel", release);
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (isLiquid()) { measure(); start(); } });

      liquidDockReset = () => {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        Object.values(L).forEach(s => snap(s, 0));
        snap(L.att, 1);
        cleanup();
      };
    }
    setupLiquidDockLens();
    const originalNavigationNextSibling = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.nextSibling : null;

    function placeNavigationForLayout(layout) {
      if (!mainNavigation || !originalNavigationParent) return;
      if (layout === "imac" || layout === "liquid") {
        // Make the dock a direct child of <body>, so fixed bottom positioning is viewport-based.
        if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(mainNavigation);
      } else if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== originalNavigationParent) {
        if (originalNavigationNextSibling && originalNavigationNextSibling.parentElement === originalNavigationParent) {
          originalNavigationParent.insertBefore(mainNavigation, originalNavigationNextSibling);
        } else {
          originalNavigationParent.appendChild(mainNavigation);
        }
      }
    }

    function applyLayout(layout, saveChoice = true) {
      const safeLayout = availableLayouts.includes(layout) ? layout : "classic";
      placeNavigationForLayout(safeLayout);
      document.body.classList.remove("layout-sidebar", "layout-moonlight", "layout-arcade", "layout-pumpkin", "layout-bottom", "layout-topbar", "layout-schoology", "layout-imac", "layout-liquid");
      if (safeLayout === "sidebar") document.body.classList.add("layout-sidebar");
      if (safeLayout === "moonlight") document.body.classList.add("layout-moonlight");
      if (safeLayout === "bottom") document.body.classList.add("layout-bottom");
      if (safeLayout === "topbar") document.body.classList.add("layout-topbar");
      if (safeLayout === "schoology") document.body.classList.add("layout-schoology");
      if (safeLayout === "imac") document.body.classList.add("layout-imac");
      if (safeLayout === "liquid") document.body.classList.add("layout-liquid");

      // Stop the Liquid Glass spring engine and clear its inline styles when leaving the theme.
      if (safeLayout !== "liquid") liquidDockReset();

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-layout-choice]").forEach(option => {
        const selected = option.dataset.layoutChoice === safeLayout;
        option.classList.toggle("selected", selected);
        option.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
      });

      if (saveChoice) {
        try { localStorage.setItem("ugsWebsiteLayout", safeLayout); }
        catch (error) { /* Settings still work for this page view if storage is blocked. */ }
      }
    }

    function setLayout(layout) {
      const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      // Fade smoothly from one layout to the next where the browser supports it.
      if (document.startViewTransition && !reduce) {
        try { document.startViewTransition(() => applyLayout(layout)); return; }
        catch (error) { /* fall through to the instant switch */ }
      }
      applyLayout(layout);
    }

    /*
      Settings window "genie": it grows out of the gear button and shrinks back into it.
      We measure where the button is relative to the window's resting spot, and the CSS
      uses those numbers (--gx, --gy, --gs) as the window's closed position and size.
    */
    let settingsClosing = false;
    let settingsCloseTimer = 0;

    function positionSettingsGenie() {
      const dialog = document.querySelector(".settings-dialog");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (!dialog || !launcher) return;

      dialog.style.transition = "none";
      dialog.style.transform = "none";
      const d = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
      const b = launcher.getBoundingClientRect();

      const dx = (b.left + b.width / 2) - (d.left + d.width / 2);
      const dy = (b.top + b.height / 2) - (d.top + d.height / 2);
      const scale = Math.max(.05, Math.min(.2, b.width / Math.max(d.width, 1)));

      dialog.style.setProperty("--gx", dx.toFixed(1) + "px");
      dialog.style.setProperty("--gy", dy.toFixed(1) + "px");
      dialog.style.setProperty("--gs", scale.toFixed(3));

      dialog.style.transform = "";
      void dialog.offsetWidth;          // commit the closed pose before animating
      dialog.style.transition = "";
    }

    function openSettings() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (overlay.classList.contains("open")) return;

      if (!settingsClosing) positionSettingsGenie();
      overlay.classList.add("open");
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

      const closeButton = overlay.querySelector(".settings-close");
      setTimeout(() => { if (overlay.classList.contains("open") && closeButton) closeButton.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 400);
    }

    function closeSettings() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (!overlay.classList.contains("open")) return;

      stopPanicCapture();
      overlay.classList.remove("open");
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

      settingsClosing = true;
      clearTimeout(settingsCloseTimer);
      settingsCloseTimer = setTimeout(() => { settingsClosing = false; }, 600);
      try { launcher.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (error) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      if (overlay && overlay.classList.contains("open")) positionSettingsGenie();
    });

    function closeSettingsFromBackdrop(event) {
      if (event.target === document.getElementById("settingsOverlay")) closeSettings();
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeSettings();
    });

    /*
      ============================================================
      SETTINGS TABS + PANIC KEY
      Defaults: key = the tilde / backtick key, link = d303.schoology.com
      ============================================================
    */
    const PANIC_DEFAULT_URL = "https://d303.schoology.com";
    const PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY = { key: "`", code: "Backquote" };
    const PANIC_STORAGE = "ugsPanicSettings";

    let panicSettings = {
      enabled: true,
      key: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.key,
      code: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.code,
      url: PANIC_DEFAULT_URL
    };
    let panicCapturing = false;
    let panicStatusTimer = 0;

    function showSettingsTab(name) {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-settings-tab]").forEach(tab => {
        const on = tab.dataset.settingsTab === name;
        tab.classList.toggle("active", on);
        tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-settings-panel]").forEach(panel => {
        panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.settingsPanel === name);
      });
      if (name !== "panic") stopPanicCapture();
    }

    function normalizePanicUrl(raw) {
      raw = String(raw || "").trim();
      if (!raw) return PANIC_DEFAULT_URL;
      if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(raw)) raw = "https://" + raw;
      try {
        const u = new URL(raw);
        if (u.protocol !== "https:" && u.protocol !== "http:") return null;
        return u.href;
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function panicKeyName(key, code) {
      if (code === "Backquote" || key === "`" || key === "~") return "` (Tilde key)";
      if (key === " ") return "Space";
      if (key && key.length === 1) return key.toUpperCase();
      return key || "Not set";
    }

    function savePanicToStorage() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(PANIC_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(panicSettings)); }
      catch (error) { /* Still works for this page view if storage is blocked. */ }
    }

    function showPanicStatus(message) {
      const box = document.getElementById("panicStatus");
      if (!box) return;
      box.textContent = message;
      clearTimeout(panicStatusTimer);
      if (message) panicStatusTimer = setTimeout(() => { box.textContent = ""; }, 3500);
    }

    function renderPanicSettings() {
      const label = document.getElementById("panicKeyLabel");
      const hint = document.getElementById("panicKeyHint");
      const btn = document.getElementById("panicKeyButton");
      const toggle = document.getElementById("panicToggle");
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      if (label) label.textContent = panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code);
      if (hint) hint.textContent = panicCapturing
        ? "Press any key now… (Esc to cancel)"
        : "Click here, then press the key you want to use.";
      if (btn) btn.classList.toggle("capturing", panicCapturing);
      if (toggle) toggle.textContent = "Panic key: " + (panicSettings.enabled ? "ON" : "OFF");
      if (input && document.activeElement !== input) {
        input.value = panicSettings.url.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
      }
    }

    function startPanicKeyCapture() {
      panicCapturing = true;
      renderPanicSettings();
    }

    function stopPanicCapture() {
      if (!panicCapturing) return;
      panicCapturing = false;
      renderPanicSettings();
    }

    function togglePanicEnabled() {
      panicSettings.enabled = !panicSettings.enabled;
      savePanicToStorage();
      renderPanicSettings();
      showPanicStatus(panicSettings.enabled ? "Panic key turned on." : "Panic key turned off.");
    }

    function savePanicSettings() {
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      const url = normalizePanicUrl(input ? input.value : "");
      if (!url) {
        showPanicStatus("That link doesn't look right. Try something like d303.schoology.com");
        return;
      }
      panicSettings.url = url;
      savePanicToStorage();
      if (input) input.value = url.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
      showPanicStatus("Saved! Press " + panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code) + " to go to " + url);
    }

    function resetPanicSettings() {
      panicSettings = {
        enabled: true,
        key: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.key,
        code: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.code,
        url: PANIC_DEFAULT_URL
      };
      panicCapturing = false;
      savePanicToStorage();
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      if (input) input.value = "";
      renderPanicSettings();
      showPanicStatus("Reset to the tilde key and d303.schoology.com.");
    }

    function triggerPanic() {
      const url = normalizePanicUrl(panicSettings.url) || PANIC_DEFAULT_URL;
      try { window.top.location.replace(url); }
      catch (error) {
        try { window.top.location.href = url; }
        catch (error2) { window.location.href = url; }
      }
    }

    function panicKeyMatches(event) {
      if (panicSettings.code) return event.code === panicSettings.code;
      return event.key === panicSettings.key;
    }

    function panicKeyHandler(event) {
      if (panicCapturing) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (event.key === "Escape") { stopPanicCapture(); return; }
        if (["Shift", "Control", "Alt", "Meta", "CapsLock", "Tab"].includes(event.key)) return;
        panicSettings.key = event.key;
        panicSettings.code = event.code || "";
        panicCapturing = false;
        savePanicToStorage();
        renderPanicSettings();
        showPanicStatus("Panic key set to " + panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code) + ".");
        return;
      }

      if (!panicSettings.enabled) return;
      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;

      const target = event.target;
      if (target && (target.tagName === "INPUT" || target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || target.isContentEditable)) return;

      if (panicKeyMatches(event)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        triggerPanic();
      }
    }

    // Listen on this page, and on the outer page too (if the browser allows it) so the key
    // still works when focus is outside the embedded site.
    document.addEventListener("keydown", panicKeyHandler, true);
    try { window.parent.document.addEventListener("keydown", panicKeyHandler, true); }
    catch (error) { /* Outer page not reachable; this page's listener is enough. */ }

    try {
      const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PANIC_STORAGE) || "null");
      if (stored && typeof stored === "object") {
        if (typeof stored.enabled === "boolean") panicSettings.enabled = stored.enabled;
        if (typeof stored.key === "string" && stored.key) panicSettings.key = stored.key;
        if (typeof stored.code === "string") panicSettings.code = stored.code;
        const safeUrl = normalizePanicUrl(stored.url);
        if (safeUrl) panicSettings.url = safeUrl;
      }
    } catch (error) { /* Use defaults when storage is unavailable. */ }
    renderPanicSettings();

    /*
      ============================================================
      RECENTLY COMPLETED (shown in the Schoology theme's side panel)
      Remembers the last 4 things you opened, newest first.
      ============================================================
    */
    const COMPLETED_STORAGE = "ugsRecentlyCompleted";
    const COMPLETED_MAX = 4;
    let completedItems = [];
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(COMPLETED_STORAGE) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(saved)) completedItems = saved.filter(x => typeof x === "string").slice(0, COMPLETED_MAX);
    } catch (error) { /* Start empty when storage is unavailable. */ }

    function renderCompleted() {
      const list = document.getElementById("sgCompleted");
      const empty = document.getElementById("sgCompletedEmpty");
      if (!list) return;
      list.replaceChildren();
      completedItems.forEach(text => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = text;
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      if (empty) empty.hidden = completedItems.length > 0;
    }

    function recordCompleted(text) {
      completedItems = completedItems.filter(item => item !== text);
      completedItems.unshift(text);
      completedItems = completedItems.slice(0, COMPLETED_MAX);
      try { localStorage.setItem(COMPLETED_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(completedItems)); }
      catch (error) { /* Still works for this page view. */ }
      renderCompleted();
    }

    // Chat, Suggestions and Ratings buttons use inline onclick handlers, so catch them here.
    document.addEventListener("click", event => {
      const button = event.target.closest && event.target.closest("button");
      const handler = button ? (button.getAttribute("onclick") || "") : "";
      if (handler.includes("openConfigured")) recordCompleted("Joined the chat!");
      else if (handler.includes("openSuggestions")) recordCompleted("Opened the suggestion box!");
      else if (handler.includes("openRatings")) recordCompleted("Rated the games!");
    }, true);

    renderCompleted();

    function goToNav(index) {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll("nav > .nav-button");
      if (buttons[index]) showPage(buttons[index].dataset.page);
    }

    let savedLayout = "classic";
    try { savedLayout = localStorage.getItem("ugsWebsiteLayout") || "classic"; }
    catch (error) { /* Use the default layout when storage is unavailable. */ }
    applyLayout(savedLayout, false);


    renderGаmеs();
    renderAnnouncements();

    /* Falling autumn leaves: a few emoji leaves drifting down the screen. */
    (function createFallLeaves() {
      const box = document.createElement("div");
      box.id = "fallLeaves";
      box.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      const icons = ["🍂", "🍁", "🍂", "🍁", "🍂"];
      const count = 12;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const leaf = document.createElement("span");
        const duration = 16 + Math.random() * 14;

        leaf.className = "fall-leaf";
        leaf.textContent = icons[i % icons.length];
        leaf.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + "%";
        leaf.style.fontSize = (16 + Math.random() * 16) + "px";
        leaf.style.animationDuration = duration + "s";
        leaf.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random() * duration) + "s";
        box.appendChild(leaf);
      }

      document.body.appendChild(box);
    })();
    
  
  </script>
</body>
</html>
